items.proposed: keep row: other (HR+/HER2- breast cancer), exploratory_correlative (non-GBM breast cohort only), candidate_matched false
items.reason: The breast cohort requires 'Diagnosis of locally advanced or HR+HER2- metastatic breast cancer'. That is a tumour molecular marker required for one cohort, which is the manual's definition of enrichment. It does not apply to the glioma cohort, which requires only 'Histologically confirmed diagnosis of high-grade glioma'.

items.coder_A: candidate_matched false (uncertain: CDK inhibitor arguably linked to HR+ breast biology)
items.reason: From established pharmacology NUV-422 is a CDK2/4/6 inhibitor, and hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer depends on oestrogen-driven cyclin D-CDK4/6 signalling, so the HR+ requirement is mechanistically linked; the row is exploratory_correlative (non-GBM cohort) and does not affect the outcomes.

Read literally, any_molecular_selection is any eligibility or enrichment biomarker, so the HR+/HER2- breast-cohort requirement counts. But it defines a non-GBM cohort's disease and does not select GBM patients, so XL may prefer to treat it like IDH-wildtype used only to define the disease and code false.
PK is planned ('Phase 1/2 Dose Escalation, Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Efficacy Study of NUV-422'), but no sample type is stated anywhere. W7 says to code unclear in exactly this case.

note: D31-A1 answers the original basket question: the HR+/HER2- requirement applies only to the non-GBM breast cohort, so the row is exploratory_correlative and any_molecular_selection is false. candidate_matched_selection stays false. A6 resolved: the HR+/HER2- row is candidate_matched true under corrected D31-A6 (NUV-422 is a CDK2/4/6 inhibitor, own pharmacological knowledge), with no effect on outcomes because the row is exploratory_correlative. tumour_pk_planned stays unclear (PK planned, sample type not stated; W7).
